engine-api.title: Engine API — node :3100 (internal only)
engine-api.cond: Auth: HS256 JWT {id, isAdmin} minted per request by cab. Guards: admin · org = owner/organiser · chair = room judge (falls through to org). Never public. ENGINE-NEW = the M9a stats PR.

phoenix-api.title: Phoenix API — /api/v1 (cab)
phoenix-api.cond: Session cookie today; keyed public API = pillar 3. Green = the engine call behind the write.

admin.title: Admin
admin.cond: is_admin only (404 otherwise). Club creation is admin-only. FOOTER (every page, all roles): beta notice + "GDPR concerns → support@uadebate.com".

public.title: Public (anonymous)
public.cond: Reads + session registration. Auth walls → /signin. Guests via /l/:code see the SAME session page (scoped) — no special guest views.

owner.title: Owner (club head)
owner.cond: FULL CONTROL restored: owner can set/publish motions and view/edit/confirm ballots on EVERY room, judge or not. Lifecycle: Start session → Reopen registration | Finish session. No cancel in the UI.

member.title: Member
member.cond: Member of several clubs — fine. Becomes Participant/Judge by registering. New: MY PAGE (global) with personal stats.

participant.title: Participant (registered speaker)
participant.cond: Member or guest — SAME session page (guest /l/:code is just auth, scoped to the session; no special guest views). History lives on the club page table, nowhere else.

judge.title: Judge (chairs a room)
judge.cond: Member-judge, guest-judge (link) or owner-as-judge — same panel, powers from the CHAIR (owner has them everywhere anyway). Judge before rooms exist = spectator.
